pairs.subject: test-harness
pairs.evidence: app/(studio)/board/_port/port.ts:35 The Board's port ignores GRAVITONE_PRODUCE_SIDE and always answers from the real side, whose weir is liveRead over v1 stores, so on the fixture lane the Board shows whatever packets this machine's stores hold (pipeline/cx-screens.mjs:96-98 says so) and its deterministic fixture side (fixture.ts) is reached by nothing.

techniques.evidence: app/(studio)/board/_port/port.ts:35 Fixture-lane Board screens inherit this machine's v1 world. The shared live lane relocates only GRAVITONE_STORE_PATH, so cx/legibility 'board' screens depend on the machine. The integration test does isolate properly (board-real.test.ts:23 mocks cwd to a temp dir and sets NEXT_PUBLIC_GRAVITONE_DATA=fixtures).
tests/live/board-exit.live.spec.ts:10 Browser-driven decisions are read back from the store and from v1's own files, not from the UI. The spec runs its own server over a seeded temp universe.
tests/next-server/board-real.test.ts:73 The test injects a clock it moves to check reconciler retry timing, instead of timing wall-clock waits.

app/(studio)/board/_port/port.ts:11 The 374-line fixture board claims parity with the kernel's rules, but no test spends it and nothing checks the claim. Unlike the part and produce fixtures, it has no parity test.
